mapper.select: SELECT l.id, l.event_id, l.message_id, l.trace_id, l.sequence_no, l.agent_name, l.phase, l.status, l.model, l.llm_input, l.llm_output, l.prompt_tokens, l.completion_tokens, l.total_tokens, l.next_decision, l.duration_ms, l.error_message, l.created_at FROM agent_observation_log l JOIN agent_conversation_message m ON m.id = l.message_id WHERE m.session_id = #{sessionId} ORDER BY l.message_id, l.sequence_no
